description: A fictional ochre foam nozzle and tank tool game prop for an engineer, chunky low-poly, held level in two hands with the nozzles forward. One long ochre painted body with wide chamfers and a thick charcoal end block closing its rear. At its front one thick dark steel head block carrying two nozzles stacked: above, one wide flat rectangular slot nozzle about 0.12 m wide with thick lips and a hollow opening; below, one fat round ring nozzle about 0.08 m across with a hollow opening. Hanging under the body ahead of the grip one large ochre cylindrical mix tank with a domed bottom, exactly two wide charcoal bands round it, one thick vertical charcoal strap down its front and a charcoal cap on its top where it meets the body. On top of the body one thick charcoal arched carry handle with two blocky feet. One short fat ribbed charcoal feed hose runs from the back of the tank curving up into the underside of the body. One diagonal-ribbed charcoal pistol grip with a squared charcoal trigger guard at the rear. One small teal lamp window in a thick charcoal bezel on the left flank above the tank. The hidden right flank is plain ochre shell.
proportions: About 0.7 m long, 0.2 m wide and 0.4 m tall. (length : width : height = 3.50 : 1 : 2.00)
sides: only the teal lamp window (flush, in its bezel) is on one flank: it sits on the LEFT flank of the body above the tank; the right flank is plain ochre shell. The head block with both nozzles, the tank with its bands and strap, the hose, the carry handle, the grip, the trigger guard and the rear end block are on the centre line (symmetric left to right).
